limitations: Synthetic 100-person cohort with 90 consecutive local calendar dates; not a clinical certification or retention measurement.
Real local Worker HTTP/D1, with harness-only deterministic time/UUID and trusted identity; public JWT/edge behavior is covered separately.
Frontend lifecycle and date-draft fixes are validated by separate real-browser tests; they do not enter this backend bundle.

Git metadata in archived workspaces may follow main; every baseline runtime input is checked against the original reference Git object, and every captured baseline bundle must match that verified build.
Latency, diagnostic response size and run timestamps are excluded from comparisons; logical HTTP responses, state, messages and decisions are compared exactly.
Failed infrastructure attempts are preserved separately and replaced with full clean shard runs; no failed records or dates are removed from a completed run.
